# FDG9126

> CONSIDER naming protected virtual members that provide extensibility points for nonvirtual members by suffixing the nonvirtual member name with “Core.”

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.9 Template Method.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: the protected virtual members are extensibility points for subclasses outside the library (FDG9124). Not an analyzer candidate: which nonvirtual member a protected virtual member is the extensibility point of is design, and the book's own conventions name other protected virtual members that nonvirtual members call differently: Dispose(bool) of the Dispose Pattern (FDG9064) and the On&lt;EventName> methods that raise events (FDG5059).

## From the book

```csharp
public void SetBounds(...){
  ...
  SetBoundsCore (...);
}
protected virtual void SetBoundsCore(...){ ... }
```
